environment.description: Node.js 18 Express application running on an EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023) with IAM role granting s3:GetObject and s3:PutObject. The application process runs as uid 1000 (appuser) but /tmp is a standard ext4 mount with no special restrictions. The container/host filesystem allows symlink creation in /tmp/uploads by any process with write access. No filesystem-level symlink protections (fs.protected_symlinks=0). The application has read access to /etc/shadow, /proc, and other sensitive paths due to running without a restrictive seccomp profile or AppArmor confinement.
